messages:
Maya Lin: quick heads-up from QA: the confirm modal on /projects sometimes gets a floating toast slapped on top when save completes. looks like the toast is stealing visual precedence at certain widths. screenshot attached.
Arjun Singh: yep reproduced. The toast sits above the modal chrome at 1366x768 when toolbar is present. Suspect a layering mix of old z constants and new layer tokens.
Priya Patel: product preference: toast actions should be brief (e.g., 'Undo' / 'View') and not push the modal content visually. Also prefer shorter display time for non-critical toasts (2.5s -> 2s).
Devon Blake: dev approach: avoid touching global spacing tokens. I'll add component-level overrides: --cmp-button-pad-inline and --cmp-button-gap, and a semantic layer map: --layer-toast, --layer-modal, --layer-fab. Then expose runtime overrides per app.
a11y-bot: checklist: ensure icon-only buttons have aria-label, enforce :focus-visible for keyboard, maintain 44px minimum touch target, toasts use aria-live="polite" unless error (role="alert"), and actions in toasts must be keyboard reachable.
Maya Lin: also noticed focus ring on primary ghost button is barely visible on light themes. Can we increase contrast of :focus-visible outline to 3:1 at minimum?
Arjun Singh: will update focus styles to use token focus.outline-color which maps to accessible contrast. We'll avoid adding pixel-based shadows.
Priya Patel: copy tweak: tooltips should describe action (e.g., "Create project") not internal token names. Also tooltip delay can be shorter on keyboard focus.
Devon Blake: quick CSS snippet I'll push to a branch:
```css
:root { --cmp-button-gap: 10px; --cmp-button-pad-y: 6px; --layer-toast: 1300; --layer-modal: 1200; }
.button--compact { padding: var(--cmp-button-pad-y) 12px; gap: var(--cmp-button-gap); min-width:44px; min-height:44px; }
.toast { z-index: var(--layer-toast); position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; transition: opacity .12s ease; }
.modal { z-index: var(--layer-modal); }
@media (max-width: 420px) { .toast-stack { display:flex; flex-direction:column-reverse; gap:10px; } }
```

Devon Blake: note I reversed stack order on mobile so newest toast doesn't cover primary CTA. pushing branch now: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/472
Maya Lin: nice. please include migration notes and a short changelog entry. Also add a bullet to PR template for visual diff screenshots on light+dark themes.
Priya Patel: +1 on screenshots. Also confirm that the shorter toast timeout won't hide actions before users can act; we'll test with keyboard users.
a11y-bot: flagged: run screen reader smoke test for toast announcements after changes.
Arjun Singh: will run tests and post results. scheduling a 10-min sync after standup to finalize tokens and copy. /remind me in 10 minutes.
